name: Acid lead

beschreibung.text: Acid lead: the 303-style acid bass lifted an octave, 60 % resonance, tube drive and a dotted 16th delay.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `lead.acid`, Welsh [B1] p. 95 (Acid Bass); the octave lift is derived, the rest is the table as printed.. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest character words outside the vocabulary: harsh (as aggressive), nasal (as thin).
